neighbours.label: English set phrases that rule out doubt or denial ('without a doubt', 'no doubt', 'without question', 'there is no denying', 'undeniably', 'unquestionably', 'doubtless', 'indisputable'), peaking on the doubt/question/deny word; quiet on 'doubt' and 'question' in their ordinary senses (having doubts, asking a question) and on plain certainty words (definitely, surely, of course)
fire: She is, without a doubt, the best pianist our town has ever produced.
No doubt the train will be late again because of the snow.
Without question, this was the hardest winter the farm had seen in decades.
There is no denying that the new bridge has cut everyone's commute in half.
The recipe is undeniably delicious, even if it takes all afternoon.
He was unquestionably the most patient teacher I ever had.
Doubtless the committee will approve the budget by Friday.
The evidence linking the leak to the old pipe was indisputable.
quiet: She had doubts about whether she was the best pianist our town had produced.
I doubt the train will be on time tomorrow because of the snow.
The reporter asked a question about the hardest winter the farm had seen.
Some residents deny that the new bridge has shortened their commute.
The recipe is definitely delicious, even if it takes all afternoon.
He was surely the most patient teacher I ever had.
Of course the committee will approve the budget by Friday.
The evidence linking the leak to the old pipe was still being questioned by the inspectors.

predictions: 8/8 fire above 0.20; near misses mostly under 0.15, 'I doubt' and 'deny' the riskiest
